snippet.title: D.O.T - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
D.O.T - Master puzzles, platform like a circle!

In D.O.T, you play as a circle navigating a series of puzzles interwoven with platform elements. In a classic graphic style featuring just two unique colors, D.O.T tests your mind and reflexes as you traverse puzzling challenges in a minimalist yet captivating world.

Wishlist now on itch.io :
itch.io : https://v38armageddon.itch.io/dot

Website: https://www.v38armageddon.net
Discord server: https://discord.gg/REnwTXQukR

Music | Sounds by : Tom Motiff
